messages:
Maya: Quick sync — post-launch hotlist + cadence. Proposing a 3-week mini-sprint: week1 hotfixes, week2 rollups/mitigations, week3 polish. Thoughts?
Priya: +1 on cadence. Which customer issues should be absolute blockers for week1?
Jon: @Maya the AcmeCorp embed latency spike is our top ticket — p99 jumped from ~800ms to ~1.2s after rollout. Repro on staging; looks like KV cache thrash on long-prefix traffic. I can ship a prefilling cache hotfix that should cut ~150-250ms.
Sam: If Jon can ship that quickly, I’d call it a bug (customer visible perf regression) not a nice-to-have perf tweak.
Maya: Agree — bug and hotfix lane. Also two spinner/stuck UI reports from support — low volume but high friction.
Alex: Those spinner reports are regressions from the last UI tweak. UX impact is real; I’d slot them as P2 enhancements unless support elevates.
Priya: Customers also asked for a per-customer "quantized model" toggle (some want fallback to full-precision for reliability). Is that a feature or a mitigation?
Jon: Practically a mitigation/ops control: add a per-customer routing flag so we can route critical accounts to the non-quantized variant. Quick to implement compared to full feature.
Sam: Rough estimate: routing flag + tests + rollout safety ~1.5 engineer-weeks. We can target week2 if we deprioritize lower-priority backlog items.
Maya: Plan proposal: week1 (hotfix lane) — Acme latency + two crashes; week2 — routing flag + canary for dedicated customers; week3 — UX polish and spinner fixes. Owners: Jon (latency hotfix), Sam (routing flag + dashboard), Alex (spinner UX). @Priya can you own customer comms?
Priya: Yep. I'll draft the customer note and update Acme. Also will set expectations that SLAs may not change until the dedicated patch is validated.
Jon: Opening hotfix PR tonight, will include perf numbers and rollout plan. @deploy-bot please queue canary for acme-staging.
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for acme-staging at 2024-06-12T22:15Z :rocket:
Priya: Add a light postmortem checklist — capture before/after metrics. Metric to include: token latency p99 by model and by customer.
Maya: Good call. Sam, can you add the dashboard panel and an alert?
Sam: On it — will add a p99 panel and an alert threshold at p99 > 1s. Will also attach the dashboard link to the PR.
Priya: One last Q — retro cadence: quick sync next Tue or wait until after week3 for full retro?
Maya: Quick sync next Tue (30m) to confirm owners + blockers, then a full retro at the end of the 3-week cycle. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
